programmes.d: Hoping to get closer to his son, Felix becomes coach of the boy's football team.
Selme Plout's scheme to snag a husband for her daughter almost forces Steve out of the crop-dusting business.
Orrin Pike is osserved buying a ring, and the family jumps to the conclusion that he's going to propose to Bobbie Jo.
Shy Orrin Pike becomes a big man when an old deed indicates he is the legal owner of the entire Hooterville Valley.
Steve's Uncle George visits the Shady Rest hotel and lives up to his repulation as a troublemaker.
Rob doesn't know what he's in for when he invites Buddy's charming, pool hustling brother over for a friendly game of billiards.
A hypnotist visits a Petrie dinner party where Rob accidentally picks up a post-hypnotic suggestion.
Rob has some explaining to do when son Ritchie learns that his middle name is Rosebud.
When Ric Vallone guest stars on 'The Alan Brady Show,' Rob grows increasingly concerned that Sally is falling for the star.
Grandma Pyle visits Gomer, reads his fortune and predicts Gomer will cause something bad to happen; then Sergeant Carter loses his voice while yelling at him.
A Colonel and his young daughter are visiting Camp Henderson. While befriending the little girl, Pyle has no problem getting her and himself in trouble with everyone.
Sgt. Carter is chosen to appear in a documentary but becomes an absurd camera hog, leaving producers no choice but to follow Gomer performing punishments Carter doles out.
After a pay phone spits out $41.75 in coins, Duke and Frankie are ecstatic about all the fun they can have spending it, but good Samaritan Gomer is determined to return it to the phone company.

Gomer wins a trip for two to Las Vegas and takes Sergeant Carter with him. The Sergeant has no money so he has to rely on Gomer for entertainment but Gomer has set an itinerary which include things like visiting a Rock Museum.
Opie Taylor runs away from Mayberry to join the Marines.
Hogan's latest escapee is a chimp from the local zoo who helps them deliver a radio part to the underground.
How can Hogan and his crew keep Sgt. Schultz from being transferred to the Russian Front?
Coming up with a fake secret device, the gonculator, Klink brings to Stalag 13 the electronics expert who wants to defect.
The Gestapo sets a trap for the elusive underground agent known as 'Papa Bear' (Hogan) and Newkirk gets caught.
Hogan's Trucking Service... We Deliver the Factory to You
The Gestapo brings three lovely ladies into the camp to interrogate the prisoners.

Mr. Haney discovers an old wish book dating back to 1898 that tells the story of Calvin and Tessie Whittaker who once owned the Douglases' farm and how Calvin traveled to Hollywood to pitch his idea of putting a mouse named Dickey into films.

Sam Drucker does not stock any cosmetics in his store, much to the chagrin of Lisa. Lisa decides to set up a 'small' display in the store. When the merchandise is delivered, it forces Mr. Drucker to retreat to the front porch.

Oliver plants his crops, worrying that they haven't been planted in time for a harvest. Lisa tries to be helpful and mixes up a batch of sour lemonade. Oliver pours out the bitter elixir in the newly planted field, with an unimaginable consequence.

Oliver has been invited to give a speech at the Bar Association. He is there to advocate for the hiring of ex-convicts. He eventually ends up regretting his speech when he is forced to hire an ex-convict by the name of Willie Dunhill.

Oliver goes to New York to finish up a case at his old firm. Meanwhile back on the farm, Lisa and Eb find a puppy left on the doorstep. Lisa, in all her innocence, leads Oliver to believe the puppy, affectionally named Freddie, is a human baby.

Hank Kimball proposes marriage to lady carpenter Ralph Monroe while under the influence of heavy medication. Lisa plans an amazing country wedding only to find out that, Sam, the Justice of the Peace, has forgotten to new his license.
When Robbie's class harasses a substitute teacher, he gets into a lot of trouble at home.
Mike and Sally argue over the wedding.
Mike and his Air Force Reservist friends collect money for a surgery for a disabled girl.
There's more than their girlfriends at risk if the boys' team loses.
While moonlighting, driving a taxi for Bert Munson, Archie is in a minor fender bender with a Jewish woman.

Roger, a friend of Mike and Gloria's, stops by. Archie takes one look and labels him as gay even though Mike insists that he isn't. Mike makes a realization that one of Archie's drinking buddies, Steve is a well-adjusted, straight-acting, gay man.
Mike is set to go down to the blood bank to donate some blood and asks Archie if he would like to donate.

Gloria comes home from the doctor with some news: she's pregnant. This leads to a big argument between Archie and Mike so Mike decides to quit school and move out. Archie doesn't believe him until Mike gets a job in Detroit and plans on moving there.
Maude storms out of her house and into a romantic little restaurant after Walter forbids her to have lunch with a handsome newly divorced 'friend.'
Arthur performs an operation he will remember all his life, when his famous practical-joking college roommate becomes more than just another patient.

Walter's out of town and Maude's life is threatened by an oversexed housepainter. With Arthur on night duty at the hospital, Maude and Vivian barricade themselves in the house and drink a little wine to ward off the cold. and a severe case of hysteria.
Maude is ecstatic over the prospect of seeing a close friend at their college class reunion, but when her friend arrives in a wheelchair, Maude heads straight for the punchbowl.
Maude's investigation into Vivian's erratic behavior reveals a new part of the Harmon's marriage and almost all of Vivian.
Maude's Aunt Lola, who is irresistible to married men -- and vice versa -- zeros in on Mrs. Naugatuck's husband, Bert, as her next conquest.

Louie carries his actions and insults too far, prompting Elaine to enlist help from a women's organization. Soon, the dispatcher's lecherous laughter is transformed into comical pleading when he is booted out of his job.
Joy blossoms at the Sunshine Cab Co. when a triumphant Bobby Wheeler returns to proclaim that he's landed a TV series role. Louie, in his own charming way, puts a damper on the celebration.
The pretty new cabbie proves to be more than Alex can handle when she leaves the meter running, in an attempt to lure him into romance.
A young runaway wreaks havoc at the Sunshine Cab Co. when Alex and Elaine encourage the lad to return home. Jim wants to adopt him, and Louie wants the youngster jailed for not paying his fare.

After Felix induces Oscar to appear on the popular talk show Steinberg is guest-hosting, his roommate gives a riotous account of Felix's prissiness. Felix is incensed, and when Steinberg invites him to make a rebuttal, he leaps at the opportunity.
Blanche tells Oscar she is remarrying and invites him and Felix to the wedding.
